newsitem.title: USA: AES shareholder sues to block merger.
newsitem.headline: AES shareholder sues to block merger.

text.p: AES Corp and AES China Generating Co Ltd said a shareholder has filed a lawsuit challenging the planned merger between the two companies.

AES said it was named a defendant in the complaint, which was filed in the Delaware Chancery Court. The suit was brought by the holder of 750 shares of AES China Generating (AES Chigen) stock and alleges that AES breached its fiduciary duty as a controlling shareholder and questions the sufficiency of the consideration to be paid to AES China Generating shareholders.
The complaint seeks damages and injunctive relief. AES China Generating was not named in the lawsuit.
AES Corp said the lawsuit is completely without merit and intends to vigorously defend itself.

AES and AES China Generating jointly announced in November that AES would acquire the publicly-held, outstanding Class A shares of AES China Generating. The amalgamation remains subject to various conditions, including the approval of the Class A shareholders of AES China Generating.
